info.title: fleet REST API
info.description: REST API for fleet nodes, served under /v1.

get.summary: Get UTXO balances for one or more addresses.
get.description:
Repeat the `address` query parameter for multiple addresses; use `POST
/v1/balances/query` instead for large batches.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Addresses to look up; repeat the parameter for multiple values

200.description: UTXO balance for the requested addresses

500.description: The mempool node could not be reached

post.summary: Batch-lookup UTXO balances for one or more addresses.

200.description: UTXO balance for the requested addresses

500.description: The mempool node could not be reached

post.summary: Batch-lookup blockchain DB entries by raw storage key.
post.description: Keys with no stored entry are omitted from the response rather than erroring.

200.description: The entries found for the requested keys

get.summary: Get a single blockchain DB entry by its raw storage key.

404.description: No entry stored at this key

get.description:
Block numbers with no stored block are omitted from the response rather than
erroring; repeat the `num` query parameter for multiple numbers.

parameters.name: num

get.summary: Get the most recently stored block.

404.description: No block has been stored yet

get.summary: Get a single stored block by number.

404.description: No block has been stored at this number

get.summary: Get node type, peer list, and route metadata for this node.

post.summary: Ask a peer to send this user node a donation.
post.description:
`address` is parsed as a socket address and a `RequestDonation` event is injected
for the node to send the request itself; no response payload is returned.

400.description: address was not a valid ip:port socket address

500.description: The donation request could not be sent

post.description:
On a mempool node, this signs and submits the item-asset creation transaction
directly (`script_public_key`/`public_key`/`signature` are required) and returns
`201` with the created asset. On a user node, this injects a creation request for
the node to construct and sign itself, and returns `202`.

201.description: Item asset created on the mempool

202.description: Item-asset creation accepted by the user node

400.description: Missing required fields for a mempool-node create

500.description: The node could not be reached, or rejected the request

get.summary: Get the latest block received for mining.

200.description: The current mining block, or `null` if none has been received yet

post.summary: Make a payment, by address or by ip.
post.description:
Both kinds first check the wallet passphrase. For `kind=address`, the node
constructs and signs the payment (`UserApi::make_payment`); a construction failure
(`success=false`) is reported as `422`, otherwise the constructed payment is queued
for sending (`SendNextPayment`) and its `tx_hash` returned. For `kind=ip`, the
`address` field is parsed as a socket address and the payment is sent directly to
that peer (`MakeIpPayment`); no `tx_hash` is available for this path.

400.description: kind=ip and address was not a valid ip:port socket address

422.description: kind=address and the payment could not be constructed

500.description: This node does not expose a wallet or cannot make payments

get.summary: Get the total and issued token supply.

500.description: The mempool node could not be reached

post.summary: Construct one or more transactions and submit them to the mempool.

201.description: The transaction(s) were accepted by the mempool

400.description: One or more transactions were malformed

500.description: The mempool node could not be reached, or rejected the transaction(s)

get.description:
An empty wallet with no outgoing transactions yet returns an empty list rather than
an error, unlike the legacy handler (which surfaced the "no key in the DB yet" case
as a `500`).

500.description: This node does not expose a wallet, or the wallet DB could not be read

get.summary: Get mempool status for one or more transactions.
get.description:
Repeat the `hash` query parameter for multiple hashes; use `POST
/v1/transactions/status:query` instead for large batches.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Transaction hashes to look up; repeat the parameter for multiple values

200.description: Status for the requested transaction hashes, keyed by hash

500.description: The mempool node could not be reached

200.description: Status for the requested transaction hashes, keyed by hash

post.summary:
Serialize one or more transactions to hex-encoded bytes, without submitting them to

AddressesQuery.description: Request body for the batch balances lookup.

oneOf.description: A quantity of the native token.

amount.description: Token amount, in raw token units.

genesis_hash.description: The genesis transaction hash the item derives from, when known.

ApiAsset.description: A chain asset, tagged by `kind` so each variant is fully described by the schema.

ApiProblem.description:
An RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` error body.

Replaces the legacy byte-envelope error path: the HTTP status is authoritative, and
this is the one typed error shape returned by every `/v1` handler.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

status.description: The HTTP status code, duplicated here per RFC 9457.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

type.description: A URI identifying the problem type; `about:blank` when none is defined.

additionalProperties.description: A single transaction output: the destination address and the asset sent to it.

address.description: The output's destination address (empty when the output has no script public key).

asset.description: The asset held by this output.

BalancesResponse.description: UTXO balance for the requested addresses.

balance.description:
The combined asset totals and per-address outpoint breakdown, as returned by
the mempool's tracked UTXO set (`fleet_core::tracked_utxo::TrackedUtxoBalance`).

BlockchainEntryResponse.description:
A single stored blockchain entry (a block or a transaction), as kept in the
blockchain DB.

data.description: The entry's JSON payload, as stored alongside the binary-encoded data.

item_meta.description: Whether this entry is a block or a transaction, with its position metadata.

key.description: The entry's raw storage key (a transaction hash, or an indexed block key).

CreateItemAcceptedResponse.description: Response body for a user-node item-asset creation request.

item_amount.description: The number of items to create.

public_key.description: Required on a mempool node (the client-signed create); ignored on a user node.

script_public_key.description: Required on a mempool node (the client-signed create); ignored on a user node.

signature.description: Required on a mempool node (the client-signed create); ignored on a user node.

CreateItemResponse.description: Response body for a mempool-node item-asset creation.

to_address.description: The address the item was created against.

tx_hash.description: The hash of the created item-asset transaction.

CreateTransaction.description:
Information necessary for the creation of a Transaction
This API would change if types are modified.

inputs.description: String to sign in each inputs

transactions.description: The transactions to construct and submit.
Per-constructed-transaction output summary, keyed by transaction hash.

CreateTxIn.description:
Information needed for the creaion of TxIn.
This API would change if types are modified.

CreateTxInScript.description: Information needed for the creaion of TxIn script.

CurrentBlockResponse.description: The latest block received for mining, if any.

block.description:
The current mining block (`fleet_core::interfaces::BlockPoWReceived`), passed
through as JSON unchanged, or `null` if no block has been received yet.

DebugData.description:
Debug/introspection payload for a node: type, peers, mounted routes, and PoW
difficulty per route. Mirrors the legacy `debug_data` handler's `DebugData`.

node_api.description: The `/v1` paths mounted on this node's router.

node_peers.description: Connected peers for this node (and the auxiliary node, if present).

node_type.description: This node's type; `"{type}/{aux_type}"` when an auxiliary node is present.

routes_pow.description: Per-route PoW difficulty, kept for parity with the legacy payload.

address.description: The `ip:port` socket address of the peer to request a donation from.

HashesQuery.description: Request body for the batch transaction-status lookup.

hashes.description: The transaction hashes to look up.

addresses.description:
Hex-encoded key-pairs to import, keyed by payment address (mirrors the legacy
`Addresses` request body / `KeypairsResponse`).

imported.description: The payment addresses that were imported.

JsonSerializedTransaction.description: A Transaction which has been serialized to JSON.

KeypairsResponse.description: Exported key-pairs, keyed by payment address.

addresses.description:
Hex-encoded key-pairs, keyed by payment address
(`fleet_wallet::AddressStoreHex`), passed through as JSON unchanged, mirroring
the legacy `Addresses` embed-as-JSON behaviour.

KeysQuery.description: Request body for the batch blockchain-entries lookup.

keys.description: The raw storage keys to look up.

LatestBlockResponse.description:
The latest stored block.

The block payload is the pre-serialized JSON the storage node already keeps
alongside the binary-encoded block (`StoredSerializingBlock`, from `fleet-core`),
passed through unchanged.

OutgoingTxsResponse.description: This node's outgoing (constructed-and-sent) transactions, keyed by hash.

transactions.description:
`[hash, transaction]` pairs (`tw_chain::primitives::transaction::Transaction`),
passed through as JSON unchanged, mirroring the legacy embed-as-JSON behaviour.

to_address.description: The payment target (address or ip:port, echoing the request).

tx_hash.description: The constructed transaction hash (present for address payments, null for ip).

PaymentKind.description: Which kind of payment target `PaymentRequest::address` names.

address.description: A payment address (kind=address) or `ip:port` socket address (kind=ip).

PeerInfo.description: A connected peer, as reported by `Node::get_peer_list` (mempool/storage peers only).

address.description: The peer's socket address, as a string.

PrettyStackEntry.description: Stack entry enum which stores Signature and PubKey items as hex strings

addresses.description: The specific addresses to refresh when `all` is false.

all.description: Refresh every known address (ignores `addresses` when true).

TxOutputSummary.description: A single transaction output: the destination address and the asset sent to it.

address.description: The output's destination address (empty when the output has no script public key).

asset.description: The asset held by this output.

WalletInfoQuery.description:
Query parameters for `GET /v1/wallet`.

The legacy handler overloaded a single `extra: Option<String>` request param to mean
either "spent" or a page number; this splits that into two typed params. With separate
params both can be set at once, so we deliberately let `spent` take precedence over
`page` (legacy never had to choose, since `extra` carried only one value).

page.description:
Which page of `transaction_pages` to return the outpoints from; defaults to the
unpaged full transaction set when omitted.

spent.description:
When `true`, return spent transactions instead of the (paged or unpaged) unspent
set.

WalletInfoResponse.description: Balance and transaction info for this node's wallet.

addresses.description:
Outpoints (with their held asset), keyed by owning address
(`fleet_core::interfaces::AddressesWithOutPoints`), passed through as JSON
unchanged (its element type has private fields, so it's serialized as-is rather
than remapped field-by-field), mirroring the legacy embed-as-JSON behaviour.

available_total.description: Tokens available to spend, in display units.

available_total_tokens.description: Tokens available to spend, in raw token units.

item_total.description: Item-asset totals, keyed by genesis hash.

locked_total.description: Tokens currently locked (e.g. immature coinbase), in display units.

locked_total_tokens.description: Tokens currently locked, in raw token units.

running_total.description: Total tokens held, in display units.

running_total_tokens.description: Total tokens held, in raw token units.
